breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the conflicting definitions for the spatial grid. The incomplete prompt provided a contradictory instruction in the preamble ('interpret Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints... and set dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)') which was inconsistent with the correct method-specific instruction ('dx=1/Nx'). The agent correctly ignored the contradictory preamble and only included the correct definition, stating 'The spatial step size is dx = 1/Nx.' This aligns with the ground truth, which removes the contradictory sentence entirely.
